They're used to distribute bug fixes, security updates, and code changes.\n\n## Patch File Format\n\n### Unified Diff Format\nMost common format, created with `diff -u`:\n\n```diff\n--- original.java    2024-01-01 10:00:00.000000000 +0000\n+++ modified.java    2024-01-01 11:00:00.000000000 +0000\n@@ -10,7 +10,12 @@\n public class Example {\n     public void method() {\n-        // Old code\n-        unsafeOperation();\n+        // New secure code\n+        if (validate()) {\n+            safeOperation();\n+        } else {\n+            throw new SecurityException(\"Validation failed\");\n+        }\n     }\n }\n```\n\n### Header Format\n```diff\n--- a/path/to/file.java\n+++ b/path/to/file.java\n```\n- `---` indicates original file (a/ prefix)\n- `+++` indicates modified file (b/ prefix)\n\n### Hunk Header\n```diff\n@@ -10,7 +10,12 @@\n```\n- First pair: original file (line 10, 7 lines)\n- Second pair: modified file (line 10, 12 lines)\n\n## Creating Patch Files\n\n### Method 1: Using diff\n```bash\ndiff -u original.java modified.java > fix.patch\n```\n\n### Method 2: Using Git\n```bash\n# After making changes\ngit diff path/to/file.java > fix.patch\n\n# Or for specific commits\ngit diff commit1 commit2 > changes.patch\n```\n\n### Method 3: Manual Creation\n```diff\n--- a/src/main/java/Example.java\n+++ b/src/main/java/Example.java\n@@ -15,6 +15,9 @@\n public void processInput(String input) {\n+    if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {\n+        throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid input\");\n+    }\n     process(input);\n }\n```\n\n## Applying Patch Files\n\n### Using patch Command\n```bash\n# Dry run to test\npatch -p1 --dry-run < fix.patch\n\n# Apply the patch\npatch -p1 < fix.patch\n\n# Reverse a patch\npatch -p1 -R < fix.patch\n```\n\n### Strip Level (-p flag)\n- `-p0`: Use full path from patch\n- `-p1`: Strip first directory component (most common)\n- `-p2`: Strip two components\n\nExample:\n```\nPatch path: a/src/main/java/File.java\n-p0: a/src/main/java/File.java\n-p1: src/main/java/File.java\n-p2: main/java/File.java\n```\n\n### Using Git\n```bash\ngit apply --check fix.patch  # Test\ngit apply fix.patch          # Apply\n```\n\n## Best Practices for Security Patches\n\n### 1. Include Context Lines\nAdd 3-5 lines of context before/after changes:\n```diff\n@@ -10,7 +10,12 @@\n     public void authenticate(String user) {\n         // Context line 1\n         // Context line 2\n-        executeQuery(user);\n+        String sanitized = sanitize(user);\n+        executeQuery(sanitized);\n         // Context line 3\n         // Context line 4\n     }\n```\n\n### 2. Multiple File Patches\nCombine fixes in one patch file:\n```diff\n--- a/src/Filter.java\n+++ b/src/Filter.java\n@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@\n // changes to Filter.java\n\n--- a/src/Validator.java\n+++ b/src/Validator.java\n@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@\n // changes to Validator.java\n```\n\n### 3. Document Changes\nAdd comments explaining security fixes:\n```java\n+        // Security fix: Validate configuration keys to prevent bypass\n+        if (config.containsKey(\"\")) {\n+            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Empty keys not allowed\");\n+        }\n```\n\n### 4. Validate Patch Application\n```bash\n# Check patch applies cleanly\npatch -p1 --dry-run < security.patch\n\n# Verify file was modified\ngit diff path/to/file.java\n\n# Compile to check syntax\njavac path/to/file.java\n```\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### Patch Fails to Apply\n```bash\n# Check for whitespace issues\npatch -p1 --ignore-whitespace < fix.patch\n\n# Try different strip levels\npatch -p0 < fix.patch\n\n# Manual merge required if context doesn't match\n```\n\n### Creating Patch from Scratch\nWhen you don't have original file:\n1. Copy file: `cp File.java File.java.orig`\n2. Make changes to `File.java`\n3. Create patch: `diff -u File.java.orig File.java > fix.patch`\n\n## Example: Security Vulnerability Fix\n\n```diff\n--- a/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/filter/JavaScriptDimFilter.java\n+++ b/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/filter/JavaScriptDimFilter.java\n@@ -45,6 +45,11 @@ public class JavaScriptDimFilter implements DimFilter {\n   @JsonCreator\n   public JavaScriptDimFilter(\n       @JsonProperty(\"dimension\") String dimension,\n       @JsonProperty(\"function\") String function\n   ) {\n+    // Security: Validate JavaScript is explicitly enabled\n+    if (!JavaScriptConfig.isEnabled()) {\n+      throw new IllegalStateException(\"JavaScript is disabled\");\n+    }\n     this.dimension = dimension;\n     this.function = function;\n   }\n```\n\n## Automated Patch Testing\n\n```bash\n#!/bin/bash\n# test-patch.sh\n\necho \"Testing patch application...\"\npatch -p1 --dry-run < \"$1\" || exit 1\n\necho \"Applying patch...\"\npatch -p1 < \"$1\" || exit 1\n\necho \"Compiling...\"\nmvn compile || exit 1\n\necho \"Patch applied successfully!\"\n```\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":4,"cache_creation_input_tokens":335,"cache_read_input_tokens":19071,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":335,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":4},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9b7426a4-5691-41a9-8b70-db26fa65ac0d","uuid":"c5730b03-7115-4496-baf3-1c9e6c42460f"}

  2024-01-01 10:00:00.000000000 +0000\n+++ modified.java    2024-01-01 11:00:00.000000000 +0000\n@@ -10,7 +10,12 @@\n public class Example {\n     public void method() {\n-        // Old code\n-        unsafeOperation();\n+        // New secure code\n+        if (validate()) {\n+            safeOperation();\n+        } else {\n+            throw new SecurityException(\"Validation failed\");\n+        }\n     }\n }\n```\n\n### Header Format\n```diff\n--- a/path/to/file.java\n+++ b/path/to/file.java\n```\n- `---` indicates original file (a/ prefix)\n- `+++` indicates modified file (b/ prefix)\n\n### Hunk Header\n```diff\n@@ -10,7 +10,12 @@\n```\n- First pair: original file (line 10, 7 lines)\n- Second pair: modified file (line 10, 12 lines)\n\n## Creating Patch Files\n\n### Method 1: Using diff\n```bash\ndiff -u original.java modified.java > fix.patch\n```\n\n### Method 2: Using Git\n```bash\n# After making changes\ngit diff path/to/file.java > fix.patch\n\n# Or for specific commits\ngit diff commit1 commit2 > changes.patch\n```\n\n### Method 3: Manual Creation\n```diff\n--- a/src/main/java/Example.java\n+++ b/src/main/java/Example.java\n@@ -15,6 +15,9 @@\n public void Files\n\n### Using patch Command\n```bash\n# Dry run to test\npatch -p1 --dry-run < fix.patch\n\n# Apply the patch\npatch -p1 < fix.patch\n\n# Reverse a patch\npatch -p1 -R < fix.patch\n```\n\n### Strip Level (-p flag)\n- `-p0`: Use full path from patch\n- `-p1`: Strip first directory component (most common)\n- `-p2`: Strip two components\n\nExample:\n```\nPatch path: a/src/main/java/File.java\n-p0: a/src/main/java/File.java\n-p1: src/main/java/File.java\n-p2: main/java/File.java\n```\n\n### Using Git\n```bash\ngit apply --check fix.patch  # Test\ngit apply Defense in Depth\n```java\n// Layer 1: Configuration validation\nvalidateConfiguration(config);\n\n// Layer 2: Check global JavaScript enabled flag\nif (!JavaScriptConfig.isEnabled()) {\n    throw new SecurityException(\"JavaScript disabled\");\n}\n\n// Layer 3: Pattern-based validation\nvalidateJavaScriptCode(jsFunction);\n\n// Layer 4: Runtime sandboxing\nexecuteInSandbox(jsFunction);\n```\n\n### 2. The vulnerability allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server through malicious JavaScript payloads.\n\n## Vulnerability Details\n\n**CVE**: Unassigned (0-day)\n**Severity**: Critical (CVSS 9.8)\n**Affected Version**: Apache Druid 0.20.0\n**Impact**: Remote Code Execution via JavaScript filter bypass\n\n### Attack Vector\n\nAttackers can execute arbitrary commands by sending malicious JSON payloads to the `/druid/indexer/v1/sampler` endpoint:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"type\": \"index\",\n  \"spec\": {\n    \"dataSchema\": {\n      \"transformSpec\": {\n        \"filter\": {\n          \"type\": \"javascript\",\n          \"function\": \"function(){java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().exec('malicious_command');}\",\n          \"\": {\n            \"enabled\": true\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\nThe empty key `\"\"` bypasses JavaScript security configuration checks, allowing:\n1. Execution of JavaScript even when disabled globally\n2. Access to dangerous Java classes like `Runtime`, `ProcessBuilder`, `System`\n3. Arbitrary command execution on the server\n\n## Security Fixes\n\n### Patch 001: JavaScript Configuration Validation\n**File**: `001-javascript-config-validation.patch`\n**Target**: `core/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/js/JavaScriptConfig.java`\n\n**Changes**:\n- Added `@JsonAnySetter` handler to reject unknown properties\n- Specifically blocks empty string `\"\"` keys\n- Prevents future bypass attempts via unknown properties\n\n**Code Added**:\n```java\n@JsonAnySetter\npublic void handleUnknownProperty(String key, Object value) {\n    if (key == null || key.isEmpty()) {\n        throw new IllegalArgumentException(\n            \"Invalid configuration: empty or null property keys are not allowed\"\n        );\n    }\n    throw new IllegalArgumentException(\n        \"Invalid configuration: unknown property '\" + key + \"' is not allowed\"\n    );\n}\n```\n\n### Patch 002: JavaScript ClassShutter Implementation\n**File**: `002-javascript-class-shutter.patch`\n**Target**: `processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/filter/JavaScriptDimFilter.java`\n\n**Changes**:\n- Added ClassShutter to sandbox JavaScript execution\n- Blocks access to dangerous Java classes\n- Prevents Runtime.getRuntime().exec() and similar attacks\n\n**Classes Blocked**:\n- `java.lang.Runtime` - Command execution\n- `java.lang.Process` / `ProcessBuilder` - Process creation\n- `java.lang.System` - System operations\n- `java.lang.Class` - Class manipulation\n- `java.lang.reflect.*` - Reflection API\n- `java.io.File` / `java.nio.file.*` - File system access\n- `java.net.URL*` - Network operations\n- `javax.script.*` - Script engine access\n- `sun.*` / `com.sun.*` - Internal APIs\n\n**Code Added**:\n```java\nprivate static final ClassShutter CLASS_SHUTTER = new ClassShutter() {\n    @Override\n    public boolean visibleToScripts(String className) {\n        if (className.startsWith(\"java.lang.Runtime\") ||\n            className.startsWith(\"java.lang.Process\") ||\n            // ... other dangerous classes\n            className.startsWith(\"com.sun.\")) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n};\n\n// In JavaScriptPredicateFactory constructor:\ncx.setClassShutter(CLASS_SHUTTER);\n```\n\n## Defense in Depth\n\nThese patches implement a multi-layered security approach:\n\n1. **Input Validation** (Patch 001): Rejects malicious configuration at deserialization\n2. **Runtime Sandboxing** (Patch 002): Blocks dangerous Java class access even if validation is bypassed\n3. **Existing Checks**: Global JavaScript enabled flag still enforced\n\n## Application Instructions\n\nThe patches have been applied to the Druid source code at `/root/druid/` and the project has been rebuilt.\n\n### Manual Application (if needed)\n\n```bash\ncd /root/druid\n\n# Apply patches\ngit apply
